correctness.rationale: For all 0≤a,b<1 the proof reduces by symmetry to a≥b. Necessity uses exact fourth-order (or quadratic when b=0) coordinate-axis expansion and mandatory monotonicity of absolute norms. Sufficiency uses exact second-derivative identity, positive substitution q=R/S, elementary inequalities under b≥a², convexity of a perspective, coordinatewise monotonicity and complex modulus triangle inequality; zero/equal-weight boundary cases are treated separately. Symbolic and finite rational diagnostic checks supplement but do not replace the universal proof.
